name: tea (Gitea CLI)
description: Gitea's official command-line tool for issues, pull requests and releases.

version.description: Channel (latest), a release line (major or major.minor), or an exact version (major.minor.patch).

stateDir.description: If set, puts this feature's data at this path, which must be inside the remote user's home. Mount a volume there to persist it across rebuilds.
